comments.body: I'm working on an EventFilter that will allow users to specify a list of mixins to suppress events about. This should be a pretty easy extension of the existing DefaultFilter, and allow for a variety of use cases where you might want to disable certain kinds of events.

https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/769

This adds a new EventFilter implementation that suppresses events on nodes with any of a given set of mixins. To use this in a running repository, you'd need to configure it in https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/blob/master/fcrepo-webapp/src/main/resources/spring/eventing.xml, replacing the existing DefaultFilter bean with something like:

<bean name="fedoraEventFilter" class="org.fcrepo.kernel.impl.observer.SuppressByMixinFilter"/>
<constructor-arg>
<value>audit:ExternalEvent</value>
<value>audit:InternalEvent</value>
</constructor-arg>
</bean>

I assume that should go in fcrepo-webapp-plus somewhere.
I've updated https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/769 to address your comments.
I've added an IT to test the SuppressByMixinFilter to https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/769

Former user, is it safe to assume that the configuration of a SuppressByMixinFilter will be documented? Maybe as a child of this page:
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FEDORA4x/Application+Configuration

Andrew Woods: I was thinking of the integration test as the documentation, but of course some explanation in the wiki will make that much more broadly useful:

https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FEDORA4x/Configuring+a+JMS+Event+Filter
That is great, Former user. Thanks for putting the wiki page up.
